name: Shandong Sacred Sun Power Sources Co.,Ltd
summary: Shandong Sacred Sun Power Sources Co.,Ltd provides green energy solutions worldwide. The company offers lithium-ion batteries, lead-acid batteries, and power systems integration. Its products are used in network power, energy storage, and motive power applications. The company is also involved in design, research and development, manufacturing and sales of energy storage batteries and systems. It serves internet companies, data center hosting service providers, telecommunications operators, financial institutions, power grids, and large power tool and smart home manufacturers. Shandong Sacred Sun Power Sources Co.,Ltd was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Qufu, China.
